arxiv-2209-13771.title: Target Features Affect Visual Search, A Study of Eye Fixations
arxiv-2209-13771.creator: Manoosh Samiei, James J. Clark
arxiv-2209-13771.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Manoosh Samiei, James J. Clark. Visual Search is referred to the task of finding a target object among a set of distracting objects in a visual display. In this paper, based on an independent analysis of the COCO-Search18 dataset, we investigate how the performance of human participants during visual search is affected by different parameters such as the size and eccentricity of the target object. We also study the correlation between the error rate of participants and search performance.

arxiv-2211-00215.title: An embedding theorem for subshifts over amenable groups with the comparison property
arxiv-2211-00215.creator: Robert Bland
arxiv-2211-00215.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Robert Bland. We obtain the following embedding theorem for symbolic dynamical systems. Let G G be a countable amenable group with the comparison property. Let X X be a strongly aperiodic subshift over G G . Let Y Y be a strongly irreducible shift of finite type over G G which has no global period, meaning that the shift action is faithful on Y Y .

arxiv-2311-08368.title: Magnetic dynamics driven integer and fractional high harmonic generation arising from highly nonlinear instantaneous energy levels
arxiv-2311-08368.creator: O. Ly
arxiv-2311-08368.description: Abstract We demonstrate that the strongly nonlinear regime of the magnetic dynamics driven high harmonic generation (HHG) can be captured through an adiabatic treatment. The underlying instantaneous energy dispersion reveal a highly nonlinear term that mirrors the high-frequency excitations present in non-equilibrium transport quantities.

arxiv-2501-02424.title: The effect of stereochemical constraints on the structural properties of folded proteins
arxiv-2501-02424.creator: Jack A. Logan, Jacob Sumner, Alex T. Grigas, Mark D. Shattuck, Corey S. O’Hern
arxiv-2501-02424.description: Abstract Proteins are composed of chains of amino acids that fold into complex three-dimensional structures. Several key features, such as the radius of gyration, fraction of core amino acids f core f_{\rm core} , packing fraction ⟨ ϕ ⟩ \langle\phi\rangle of core amino acids, and structure factor S ⁡ ( q ) S(q) define the structure of folded proteins.

arxiv-2510-17709.title: Closing the Sim2Real Performance Gap in RL
arxiv-2510-17709.creator: Akhil S Anand, Shambhuraj Sawant, Jasper Hoffmann, Dirk Reinhardt, Sebastien Gros
arxiv-2510-17709.description: Abstract Sim2Real aims at training policies in high-fidelity simulation environments and effectively transferring them to the real world. Despite the developments of accurate simulators and Sim2Real RL approaches, the policies trained purely in simulation often suffer significant performance drops when deployed in real environments. This drop is referred to as the Sim2Real performance gap.

pmc-12512921.title: Facial volume reduction and masticatory function after masseter botulinum toxin injection: a prospective study
pmc-12512921.creator: Napasorn Sawadsopanont, Kanin Arunakul, Chanita Tantipoj
pmc-12512921.description: BackgroundBotulinum toxin type A (BTX-A) is widely used for masseter reduction to improve lower facial contour. While its esthetic effects are well established, the potential impact on masticatory function remains unclear, particularly in healthy individuals. This study aimed to evaluate changes in facial volume, patient satisfaction, and perceived chewing function following BTX-A injection.

pmc-13031951.description: The establishment of Agricultural Product Quality and Safety Counties not only enhances the quality and safety standards of agricultural products, effectively ensuring food safety and consumption security, but also holds significant implications for accelerating the transformation of agricultural development patterns and advancing modern agriculture.

pmc-13085585.title: Defining associated factors for total fertilization failure and embryo development arrest in intracytoplasmic sperm injection cycles
pmc-13085585.creator: Mustafa Akşar, Serdar Dilbaz
pmc-13085585.description: BackgroundTotal fertilization failure (TFF) and embryo developmental arrest (EDA) remain clinically challenging outcomes in intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) cycles. Although ICSI is widely and effectively used to overcome fertilization disorders, fertilization failure and embryo development arrest continue to occur in a subset of patients.

pmc-13315783.title: Household mobility responses to weather extremes in Kyrgyzstan
pmc-13315783.creator: Barchynai Kimsanova, Thomas Herzfeld, Atabek Umirbekov, Kathleen Hermans, Daniel Müller, Nodir Djanibekov
pmc-13315783.description: Weather extremes increasingly shape human mobility, yet their effects differ across households and locations. We advance understanding of climate-related mobility by distinguishing among four outcomes: domestic mobility, international mobility, combined domestic-international mobility, and immobility, rather than treating mobility as a simple binary choice.

pmc-13348543.title: Short-term Functional Outcomes of Shoulder Girdle Limb Salvage in Primary Bone Tumors: A 2-year Follow-up Study

pmc-13348543.description: Introduction:The shoulder girdle, encompassing the proximal humerus, scapula, lateral third of the clavicle, and surrounding soft tissues, is the third most frequent site for bone tumors. The proximal humerus is the most commonly affected area, followed by the scapula and clavicle.

pmc-13613715.title: Ultrasound assessment of muscle atrophy and its association with functional outcomes in critically ill patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13613715.creator: Chen-Chun Lin, Yi-Jia Lin, Chi-Tsung Chen, Hsiao-Min Chou, Wei-Chun Hsu
pmc-13613715.description: BackgroundCritically ill patients experience rapid skeletal muscle wasting due to immobility and systemic inflammation. Traditional imaging modalities—including computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, and dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry—can accurately quantify muscle mass but are impractical for monitoring critically ill patients because of cost, radiation, and logistical constraints.
